mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.product_id AS productId, s.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, ovs.option_value_id AS optionValueId FROM sku s LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ovs.sku_id = s.sku_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY s.sku_id

SELECT s.sku_id, s.product_id, s.stock_quantity, GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT(po.option_name, ': ', pov.option_value) ORDER BY po.option_name SEPARATOR ' / ' ) AS option_summary FROM sku s LEFT JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ovs.sku_id = s.sku_id LEFT JOIN product_option_value pov ON ovs.option_value_id = pov.option_value_id LEFT JOIN product_option po ON pov.option_id = po.option_id WHERE s.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY s.sku_id
